verdict.summary:
Fix run on Stage 1 PR #1 (LIN-GTB-2): both kb-critic findings fixed.
DEC-0008 aligns the 280-character count across clients and orders-service (code points, CR LF as one); DEC-0009 defines client behaviour on a rejected note.
FR-0002 and FR-0003 gain AC-6; FR-0001.AC-1 now requires deliveryNote in the order list too.
All three ready requirements amended as change proposals with Change history entries. One commit, fbf2c2e.

finding_responses.note: Added DEC-0008 (web shop and app count the same unit as orders-service: Unicode code points after trimming; CR LF normalised to one LF before counting at both ends; marked as amending DEC-0001 and DEC-0003) and DEC-0009 (on an HTTP 400 for the note the clients place no order, show the error at the field and keep the input). FR-0001.AC-3 names DEC-0008 with 56/57-emoji and CR LF example rows; FR-0002 and FR-0003 AC-3 name the counting unit (code points, not grapheme clusters) and both gain AC-6 for a rejected note.
finding_responses.evidence: decisions.md rows DEC-0008, DEC-0009; prd/requirements/FR-0001.md AC-3 and Examples; prd/requirements/FR-0002.md AC-3, AC-6; prd/requirements/FR-0003.md AC-3, AC-6; commit fbf2c2e

finding_responses.note: FR-0001.AC-1 reworded to require the note both when the order is fetched alone and on each order in the customer's order list, each carrying its own deliveryNote; an example row for a fetched order list (one order with a note, one with null) added.
finding_responses.evidence: prd/requirements/FR-0001.md AC-1 and the last Examples row; commit fbf2c2e
